metadata.purpose: FarmTwin — цифровой двойник свинокомплекса: площадки, секции, алармы, тренды, кормление, здоровье, видео, роботы, прослеживаемость, задания, СППР, интеграции
metadata.ui: React SPA ui-pack farmtwin-ui · /apps/farmtwin/ · BFF hub root.platform.devices.farmtwin.hub
metadata.changelog: 1.1.0 — Marketplace package: app listing + ui-pack companion; remove operator SPA iframe tab; Open app UI via hosted ui-pack.
metadata.deployNote: Deploy application bundle + install ui-pack (marketplace uiPackSlug or drop-in ISPF_UI_PACKS_DIR/farmtwin). Tree scripts MUST set dataSourcePath=root.platform.data-sources.farmtwin.

source.body: {"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, code, name, site_type AS type, sections_count AS sections, livestock, status FROM ft_site ORDER BY code) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, site_id AS \"siteId\", name, pigs, temp, humidity, ventilation, feed_ok AS \"feedOk\", water_ok AS \"waterOk\", state FROM ft_section ORDER BY site_id, name) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, site_id AS \"siteId\", name, pigs, temp, humidity, ventilation, feed_ok AS \"feedOk\", water_ok AS \"waterOk\", state FROM ft_section WHERE site_id = ? ORDER BY name) t", "params": ["${input.siteId}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT key, value FROM ft_kpi ORDER BY key) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, to_char(at_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow','YYYY-MM-DD\"T\"HH24:MI:SS') AS time, site_id AS \"siteId\", source, message, severity, status, tag FROM ft_alarm ORDER BY at_ts DESC) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE ft_alarm SET status='acked' WHERE id = ? AND status='active'", "params": ["${input.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "id": "${input.id}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE ft_alarm SET status='cleared' WHERE id = ?", "params": ["${input.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "id": "${input.id}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, name, unit, color FROM ft_trend_param ORDER BY id) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT param_id AS \"paramId\", t_label AS t, value AS v, sort_order AS \"sortOrder\" FROM ft_trend_point ORDER BY param_id, sort_order) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, title, source, site_id AS \"siteId\", assignee, status, priority, to_char(due_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS due FROM ft_task ORDER BY due_at) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE ft_task SET status = ? WHERE id = ?", "params": ["${input.status}", "${input.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "id": "${input.id}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO ft_task (id,title,source,site_id,assignee,status,priority,due_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'new', COALESCE(?, 'normal'), COALESCE(?::timestamptz, NOW() + interval '4 hours'))", "params": ["${input.id}", "${input.title}", "${input.source}", "${input.siteId}", "${input.assignee}", "${input.priority}", "${input.due}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "id": "${input.id}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT d.id, d.severity, d.title, d.recommendation, d.site_id AS \"siteId\", d.status,\n        COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(a.text ORDER BY a.ord) FROM ft_decision_action a WHERE a.decision_id = d.id), '[]'::json) AS actions\n        FROM ft_decision d WHERE d.status = 'active' ORDER BY CASE d.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'warning' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, d.id) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO ft_task (id,title,source,site_id,assignee,status,priority,due_at) SELECT ?, d.title, 'СППР', d.site_id, 'Оператор СППР', 'new', CASE WHEN d.severity='critical' THEN 'high' ELSE 'normal' END, NOW() + interval '4 hours' FROM ft_decision d WHERE d.id = ?", "params": ["${input.taskId}", "${input.id}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE ft_decision SET status='accepted' WHERE id = ?", "params": ["${input.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "id": "${input.id}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE ft_decision SET status='rejected', reject_comment = ? WHERE id = ?", "params": ["${input.comment}", "${input.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "id": "${input.id}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, name, protocol, status, lag_sec AS \"lagSec\" FROM ft_integration ORDER BY name) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE ft_integration SET lag_sec = GREATEST(1, lag_sec), status = CASE WHEN status='offline' THEN 'degraded' ELSE status END WHERE id = ?", "params": ["${input.id}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT id, name, protocol, status, lag_sec AS \"lagSec\" FROM ft_integration WHERE id = ?", "params": ["${input.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "id": "${row.id}", "status": "${row.status}", "lagSec": "${row.lagSec}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, pen, activity, norm, risk, note, temp, group_size AS \"groupSize\", COALESCE(actions_json, '[]') AS actions FROM ft_health_case ORDER BY CASE risk WHEN 'высокий' THEN 0 WHEN 'средний' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, name, place, status, kind, fps, bitrate, latency_ms AS \"latencyMs\", storage FROM ft_camera ORDER BY name) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, to_char(at_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow','HH24:MI') AS time, place, factor, animal_count AS count, severity, detail, cam_id AS \"camId\" FROM ft_video_event ORDER BY at_ts DESC) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, name, load_pct AS load, state FROM ft_detector ORDER BY name) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, name, site_code AS \"siteCode\", state, battery, mode, last_job AS \"lastJob\" FROM ft_robot ORDER BY id) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, robot_id AS \"robotId\", at_label AS t, text, zone, route FROM ft_robot_mission ORDER BY id DESC) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE ft_robot SET state='run', last_job = ?, mode = 'задание' WHERE id = ?", "params": ["${input.job}", "${input.id}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO ft_robot_mission (id,robot_id,at_label,text,zone,route) VALUES (?, ?, to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow','HH24:MI'), ?, COALESCE(?, '—'), COALESCE(?, '—'))", "params": ["${input.missionId}", "${input.id}", "${input.job}", "${input.zone}", "${input.route}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "id": "${input.id}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, rfid, pen, board, status FROM ft_animal ORDER BY id) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, at_label AS t, rfid, place, result FROM ft_scan ORDER BY id DESC) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE ft_animal SET board = ?, status = 'на месте' WHERE id = ?", "params": ["${input.board}", "${input.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "id": "${input.id}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, name, email, role, site_id AS \"siteId\" FROM ft_user ORDER BY name) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT site_id AS \"siteId\", activity_norm AS \"activityNorm\", temp_risk AS \"tempRisk\" FROM ft_sppr_config ORDER BY site_id) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO ft_sppr_config (site_id, activity_norm, temp_risk) VALUES (?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (site_id) DO UPDATE SET activity_norm = EXCLUDED.activity_norm, temp_risk = EXCLUDED.temp_risk", "params": ["${input.siteId}", "${input.activityNorm}", "${input.tempRisk}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": ""}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT json_build_array(json_build_object('sites', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(s)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT id, code, name, site_type AS type, sections_count AS sections, livestock, status FROM ft_site ORDER BY code) s),'sections', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(x)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT id, site_id AS \"siteId\", name, pigs, temp, humidity, ventilation, feed_ok AS \"feedOk\", water_ok AS \"waterOk\", state FROM ft_section ORDER BY site_id, name) x),'alarmsActive', (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM ft_alarm WHERE status='active'),'tasksOpen', (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM ft_task WHERE status IN ('new','in_progress','overdue'))))::text AS rows"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

reports.title: Площадки
reports.query: SELECT code, name, site_type, livestock, status FROM ft_site ORDER BY code

reports.title: Секции
reports.query: SELECT name, site_id, pigs, temp, humidity, ventilation, state FROM ft_section ORDER BY site_id, name

reports.title: Аварии
reports.query: SELECT to_char(at_ts,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS at, site_id, source, message, severity, status FROM ft_alarm ORDER BY at_ts DESC

reports.title: Задания
reports.query: SELECT title, site_id, assignee, status, priority, to_char(due_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS due FROM ft_task ORDER BY due_at

reports.title: Интеграции
reports.query: SELECT name, protocol, status, lag_sec FROM ft_integration ORDER BY name

reports.title: Роботы
reports.query: SELECT name, site_code, state, battery, mode, last_job FROM ft_robot ORDER BY id

reports.title: Здоровье
reports.query: SELECT pen, activity, norm, risk, note FROM ft_health_case ORDER BY risk

reports.title: СППР
reports.query: SELECT severity, title, recommendation, site_id, status FROM ft_decision ORDER BY id

reports.title: Прослеживаемость
reports.query: SELECT id, rfid, pen, board, status FROM ft_animal ORDER BY id
